Class OrchestratorSkillExecutor

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.executor.AbstractAgentExecutor
tech.kayys.wayang.agent.executor.OrchestratorSkillExecutor
All Implemented Interfaces:
tech.kayys.gamelan.sdk.executor.core.WorkflowExecutor
@Executor(executorType="agent-orchestrator", communicationType=GRPC, maxConcurrentTasks=5) @ApplicationScoped public class OrchestratorSkillExecutor extends AbstractAgentExecutor
Orchestrator executor that coordinates multiple skill-based agents.

Uses the same skill-based architecture as SkillBasedAgentExecutor but adds multi-agent coordination capabilities: delegating sub-tasks to other agents, synthesizing results, and managing execution flow.

Like any agent, the orchestrator's behavior is defined by its skill (default: "orchestrator"). Its skill definition includes an SkillDefinition.OrchestrationConfig that declares default child skills, orchestration type, and coordination strategy.
